card.name: Inside the word EXACERBATION in warnings
card.fires_on: The piece "B" in the middle of the capitalized word EXACERBATION. It appears in boxed warning headings about acute exacerbation of hepatitis B or D after treatment.

modes.label: EXACERBATION heading
modes.description: The "B" piece partway through capitalized EXACERBATION(S) in a hepatitis warning title.
modes.example: WARNING: POST TREATMENT ACUTE EXACER<<B>>ATION OF HEPATITIS B

card.plain: It marks the middle of the word EXACERBATION in the all-caps hepatitis B flare warning title.
